name: mentor
description: Mentor mode: Claude points the way instead of writing your code. Blocks file edits, gates requests for ready-made code until you have tried, escalates hints step by step and reviews your week.

language.title: Language of hook messages
language.description: pl or en. Claude itself answers in the language you write in.

off_minutes.title: Pause length (minutes)
off_minutes.description: How long /mentor:off lifts the blocks before mentor mode comes back on its own.

focus_topics.title: Focus topics
focus_topics.description: Comma-separated areas you want to grow in, e.g. 'Angular signals, RxJS, networking'. Used by /mentor:whats-new and the weekly quiz.

bash_guard.title: Ask before file-writing shell commands
bash_guard.description: Best effort: shell commands that look like they write files (redirects, sed -i, Set-Content, git apply…) trigger a permission prompt while mentor mode is on.

gate_regex.title: Custom gate pattern (regex)
gate_regex.description: Case-insensitive regex for prompts that ask for ready-made code. Empty = built-in Polish + English pattern.
